agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
July 2, 2025, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for May 7, 2025, and June 4, 2025, Planning
  Commission meeting(s).

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by George Kelly,
  representing Rhythm Bar, for Special Use Permit No. 25-00011
  (SUP25-00011) to allow the on-site sale of beer, wine, and
  distilled spirits and live entertainment in an approximately
  3,081 square-foot proposed bar and lounge that is part of the
  Hollywood Park Tomorrow retail center on a Mixed-Use designated
  HPSP (Hollywood Park Specific Plan) zoned property located at
  1269 South District Drive.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-073) has been prepared,
  stating that the proposed project is categorically exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act. A copy of this notice
  is available for public review in the Planning Division office
  of City Hall and upon request via email to
  al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-073;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00011.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1)Take the above actions, but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Ray Gipson,
  representing Queen of Sheba, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00014(SUP25-00014) to allow the sale of distilled spirits for
  on-site consumption and live entertainment for an existing
  restaurant on a MU-C (Mixed Use Corridor) zoned property located
  at 630 North La Brea Avenue.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-076) has been prepared,
  stating that the proposed project is categorically exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act. A copy of this notice
  is available for public review in the Planning Division office
  of  City  Hall  and  upon  request  via  email  to
  smay@cityofinglewood.org.
   Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-076;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00014.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1)Take the above actions, but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

  c. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 25-00001
  (ZCA25-00001) to modify miscellaneous regulations in Chapter 12
  of the Inglewood Municipal Code related to Accessory Dwelling
  Units, Fence Regulations, and Public Art Review, Citywide.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-060) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City Hall and via email at crivera@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-060;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving ZCA25-00001.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1)Take the above actions, but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

If the Planning Commission meeting of July 2, 2025, is not held, or is
concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item being
considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item will
automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 6, 2025, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
